status: PAPER TEST, not a live list
title: Paper test #2: Quality Growth + Trend (QGT)
method: Growing, cash-generative companies with earnings surprises and an uptrend, commodity producers excluded. Universe: US-listed stocks over $2B with SEC us-gaap filings (870 stocks; 110 pass every rule), excluding financials, real estate, bitcoin miners and crypto-treasury companies. Percentile ranks are across that universe. Picks are the top 12 in score order with at most 3 per industry and 6 semiconductor/hardware names; the next 13 are backups. As backtested, picks are held for a quarter: weekly refreshes update the numbers, and the list is rebuilt at the quarterly rebalance (next: 2027-02-22).

rubric.component: Share count up less than 3% in 12 months

rubric.how: Ranked by the average percentile of earnings surprise (SUE), latest-quarter revenue growth YoY, gross-margin change, cash quality and 12-1 momentum.

dataNotes: Fundamentals: SEC XBRL companyfacts, originally filed values, filings public by the 2026-11-23 close; quarters older than 230 days are ignored. Prices: Yahoo daily adjusted closes (month-end closes for the 10-month average, momentum and volatility; daily closes for the 150/200-day averages). Forward P/E, PEG, analysts and targets: StockAnalysis. Same code as the Nov 23, 2026 backtest harness.
backtest: Backtest 2012–Nov 2026: +2.5%/yr vs the same-universe equal-weight basket (top 1,000; 2012–19 −1.5, 2020–26 +7.2), max drawdown about −34%. 1975–2025 proxy check: +2.9%/yr vs the market; +6.5%/yr in 1975–2004. Fell about 33% in Jul–Nov 2026.
disclaimer: Paper test only (user-approved Nov 23, 2026): not a live list, nothing is traded, and the live screeners are unchanged. Backtests overstate future returns. Not financial advice.
